title: Building
description: One commercial building (contract v1.1.0). Source fields are named in each description; see docs/DATA_NOTES.md.

id.description: Waterline slug, for example 'building-a' or 'fixture-1'. The CoStar PropertyId is never exposed: it stays in the server's git-ignored mapping (data/cache/shortlist.json).

name.description: CoStar `buildingName`; often null, so the UI falls back to `address`.

address.description: Built from CoStar `primaryAddress` (streetNumber, streetName, streetType, city, state, postcode).

property_subtype.description: CoStar `propertySubtype`, decoded with enums.json PropertySubtype (for example Industrial_Warehouse).

size_basis.description: Always GBA: filled on every Houston retail, industrial and flex record.

year_built.description: Latest `constructionEvents[].year` with eventType 2 (ConstructionComplete); can be approximate.

stories.description: CoStar `numStoriesAboveGrade`. 1 means every scan of the building is on the ground floor.

tenants.description: Names of current tenants: location-occupancy rows with null `toDate`, joined on `tenantLocationId` to company-detail `id`. May be out of date.

value_usd.description: Assessor total value (`assessment.totalValue`) from the most recent CoStar sale comp on this property; null when there is none. Not a market value.

improvement_value_usd.description: Assessor improvement value (`assessment.improvedValue`, buildings only, no land) from the same sale comp. Basis for structure loss when present.

value_as_of.description: `soldDate` of the sale comp the values come from.

value_source.description: Plain-text citation without CoStar ids, for example 'CoStar sale comp, deed assessment, 1 parcel matched by APN, assessment year 2024'.

matterport_model_id.description: The Matterport model used for the interior survey (a `videoKey` on a property attachment with videoExternalReferenceType 36 or 234).

matterport_model_ids.description: All Matterport model ids on the property (commercial-properties.csv MatterportModelId).

scan_area_sqft.description: Matterport `model.dimensions(units: imperial).areaFloor` of `matterport_model_id`. Often far below size_sqft: a scan may cover only part of the building.

scan_coverage.description: min(scan_area_sqft / size_sqft, 1). Capped at 1 because a scan can measure more floor than CoStar's GBA (covered outdoor areas, mezzanines, or a GBA that is out of date). Interior loss covers the scanned area only; structure loss is scaled by this share.

in_mapped_flood_zone.description: FEMA NFHL layer 28 `SFHA_TF` == 'T' (inside the 1% annual-chance Special Flood Hazard Area). Shaded zone X (0.2%) is false. Null when there is no NFHL coverage.

flood_zone.description: FEMA NFHL `FLD_ZONE`, for example AE, AO, X.

flood_zone_subtype.description: FEMA NFHL `ZONE_SUBTY`, for example FLOODWAY, '0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD', 'AREA OF MINIMAL FLOOD HAZARD'.

ground_elevation_ft.description: Ground elevation at (lat, lng) in feet, NAVD 88 (USGS EPQS interpolates 3DEP, whose elevations over the contiguous US are NAVD 88; the response itself states no datum). Same datum as FEMA's NFHL elevations in Harris County (V_DATUM NAVD88). A single point; GET /buildings/{id}/grounding has the sampled ground around the building (v1.3).

ground_elevation_source.description: 'USGS EPQS' (default) or 'Vexcel ground-elevation.value'. On the shortlist Vexcel is 1.1 ft below to 3.8 ft above USGS.

aerial_collection.description: Vexcel collection of the aerial image shown, from the image XMP `Vexcel:collection`.
